description: This is an __init__.py file for the assemblyai submodule within the pipecat.services package. It imports the sys module and a DeprecatedModuleProxy class, then dynamically replaces the module in sys.modules with a proxy to deprecate or redirect access to the 'assemblyai.stt' submodule.

classes.name: DeprecatedModuleProxy
classes.description: A proxy class used to mark modules or parts of modules as deprecated, likely issuing warnings when accessed.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DeprecatedModuleProxy, initializes the proxy with the original module's globals, a name, and a target module path.
